attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Mouseover Rebirth
macros.desc: Resurrect a dead friendly mouseover, or your selected dead ally.
macros.needs: Rebirth learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Renascimento
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead][help,dead][] Renascimento

macros.title: Mouseover Remove Curse
macros.desc: Cleanse a friendly mouseover, your target, or yourself.
macros.needs: Remove Curse learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Remover Maldição
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Remover Maldição

macros.title: Mouseover Cure Poison or Abolish Poison
macros.desc: Cure a poison on the friendly under your cursor, your target or yourself, or hold Shift for Abolish Poison. You leave your form first.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Cure Poison
/cancelform
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Abolish Poison; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cure Poison

keys.text: Cure Poison on your mouseover, target or yourself
Abolish Poison on your mouseover, target or yourself

macros.needs: Cure Poison learned; Abolish Poison for the Shift half
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Curar Veneno
/cancelform
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Abolir Veneno; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Curar Veneno

macros.title: Rebirth in combat, Revive outside it
macros.desc: Rebirth the dead player under your cursor or your target while you're in combat, and Revive them when you're not.
macros.needs: Revive learned at 12; Rebirth learned at 20
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [combat] Renascimento; Reviver
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead,combat][help,dead,combat] Renascimento
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead,nocombat][help,dead,nocombat] Reviver

macros.title: Mouseover Innervate
macros.desc: Leave your form and Innervate the friendly under your cursor, your target or yourself.
macros.needs: Innervate learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Avivar
/cancelform
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Avivar

macros.title: Mouseover Mark of the Wild or Thorns
macros.desc: Buff the friendly under your cursor, your target or yourself with Mark of the Wild, or with Thorns while you hold Shift. You leave your form first.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Thorns; Mark of the Wild
/cancelform
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Thorns; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Mark of the Wild

keys.text: Mark of the Wild on your mouseover, target or yourself
Thorns on your mouseover, target or yourself

macros.needs: Thorns learned for the Shift half
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Espinhos; Marca do Indomado
/cancelform
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Espinhos; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Marca do Indomado

macros.title: Cat Form or Bear Form on one key
macros.desc: Dismount and go into Cat Form, or into Bear Form while you hold Shift; swap in Dire Bear Form once you learn it at 40.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Bear Form; Cat Form
/dismount
/cast [mod:shift] Bear Form; Cat Form
macros.needs: Bear Form and Cat Form learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Forma de Urso; Forma de Felino
/dismount
/cast [mod:shift] Forma de Urso; Forma de Felino

macros.title: Travel, Aquatic or Cat Form on one key
macros.desc: Aquatic Form when you're swimming, Travel Form outdoors and Cat Form anywhere else, dismounting you first.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/dismount
/cast [swimming] Aquatic Form; [outdoors] Travel Form; Cat Form
macros.needs: Aquatic Form, Travel Form and Cat Form learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/dismount
/cast [swimming] Forma Aquática; [outdoors] Forma de Viagem; Forma de Felino

macros.title: Heal from any form
macros.desc: Leave your form and cast Healing Touch on the friendly under your cursor, or on yourself; hold Shift for Regrowth instead.

keys.text: Healing Touch on your mouseover or yourself
Regrowth on your mouseover or yourself

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Toque de Cura
/cancelform
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Recrescimento; [@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Toque de Cura

macros.title: Drop your form and dismount
macros.desc: Stop your cast, leave your shapeshift and get off your mount in one press.
macros.codePt:
/stopcasting
/cancelform
/dismount

macros.title: Barkskin, Shift for Nature's Grasp
macros.desc: Use Barkskin in your current form, or hold Shift for Nature's Grasp. Neither branch cancels your form in Forever.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Nature's Grasp; Barkskin
/cast [mod:shift] Nature's Grasp; Barkskin
macros.needs: Barkskin learned; Nature's Grasp is baseline at level 10 in Forever
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Enredamento; Pele de Árvore
/cast [mod:shift] Enredamento; Pele de Árvore

macros.title: Mouseover Moonfire
macros.desc: Apply Moonfire to another enemy while keeping your main target.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Lunar
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Fogo Lunar

macros.title: Starfire or Wrath
macros.desc: Hold Shift for Wrath; press normally for Starfire.
macros.needs: Starfire learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Ira; Fogo Estelar
/cast [mod:shift] Ira; Fogo Estelar

macros.title: Mouseover Insect Swarm
macros.desc: Swarm the enemy under your cursor, or your target when there isn't one.
macros.needs: Insect Swarm talent (in the Balance tree in Forever)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Nuvem de Insetos
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Nuvem de Insetos

macros.title: Moonfire, then Insect Swarm
macros.desc: Press it twice to put Moonfire and then Insect Swarm on your target; the sequence starts over when you change target.
macros.needs: Insect Swarm talent (in the Balance tree in Forever)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Lunar
/castsequence reset=target Fogo Lunar, Nuvem de Insetos

macros.title: Wrath, then two Starfires
macros.desc: Runs Wrath and two Starfires in a row, the way the Eclipse talent describes it.
macros.needs: Eclipse talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Estelar
/castsequence reset=target/12 Ira, Fogo Estelar, Fogo Estelar

macros.title: Mouseover Entangling Roots
macros.desc: Root the enemy under your cursor, or your target; you can only keep one enemy rooted at a time unless you take Overgrowth.
macros.needs: Entangling Roots learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raízes Enredantes
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Raízes Enredantes

macros.title: Mouseover Hibernate
macros.desc: Put the beast or dragonkin under your cursor to sleep, or your target if there's no mouseover; damage wakes it.
macros.needs: Hibernate learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Hibernar
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Hibernar

macros.title: Mouseover Faerie Fire
macros.desc: Faerie Fire the enemy under your cursor, or your target; while it's on, the enemy can't stealth or turn invisible. Bear, Cat and Dire Bear casts cost no resources and have a 6 sec cooldown.
macros.needs: Faerie Fire learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Feérico
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Fogo Feérico

macros.title: Hurricane without restarting it
macros.desc: Nothing happens while you're already channeling, so mashing the key can't cut your own Hurricane short; click the ground as usual.
macros.needs: Hurricane learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Furacão
/stopmacro [channeling]
/cast Furacão

macros.title: Primal Bite and auto attack
macros.desc: Use Forever’s renamed Feral talent while keeping auto attack on.
macros.needs: Primal Bite talent, which now needs Leader of the Pack; Bear or Dire Bear Form
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Mordida Primeva
/startattack
/cast Mordida Primeva

macros.title: Mouseover Growl
macros.desc: Taunt an enemy under your cursor without dropping your current target.
macros.needs: Bear Form and Growl learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Rosnar
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Rosnar

macros.title: Powershift into Cat Form
macros.desc: Leave and re-enter Cat, one step per press. Furor can regenerate Energy outside Cat, and Shifting Power also turns Mana into Energy.
macros.needs: Furor talent, now in the Feral tree; Cat Form
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Forma de Felino
/cancelform [noform:3]
/cast [form:3] Forma de Felino
/cast [noform:3] !Forma de Felino

macros.title: Dismount, Cat Form and Prowl
macros.desc: Dismount and enter Cat Form if needed, then press again after the global cooldown to Prowl. Repeated presses while hidden leave you in Stealth.
macros.needs: Cat Form and Prowl learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Espreitar
/dismount
/cast [noform:3] Forma de Felino
/cast [form:3,nostealth,nocombat] Espreitar

macros.title: Ravage from stealth, Shred otherwise
macros.desc: Ravage while you're Prowling and Shred once you're not; auto attack only starts after the opener. Both need you behind the target.
macros.needs: Cat Form; behind your target
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth] Assolar; Despedaçar
/startattack [nostealth]
/cast [stealth] Assolar; Despedaçar

macros.title: Ferocious Bite, Shift for Rip
macros.desc: Spend your combo points on Ferocious Bite, or hold Shift for Rip.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Rip; Ferocious Bite
/cast [mod:shift] Rip; Ferocious Bite
macros.needs: Cat Form
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Rasgar; Mordida Feroz
/cast [mod:shift] Rasgar; Mordida Feroz

macros.title: Mouseover Lacerate
macros.desc: Stack Lacerate on the enemy under your cursor, or your target, and keep auto attack going.
macros.needs: Lacerate talent (Feral), no longer a trainer spell; Bear Form or Dire Bear Form
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Lacerar
/startattack
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Lacerar

macros.title: Enrage into Frenzied Regeneration
macros.desc: Enrage for its instant 10 Rage, then Frenzied Regeneration to turn that Rage into health. With enough Rage over its duration, Frenzied Regeneration can restore your full maximum health.
macros.needs: Bear Form or Dire Bear Form; Frenzied Regeneration learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Regeneração Frenética
/cast [form:1] Enfurecer
/cast Regeneração Frenética

macros.title: Swipe, Shift for Demoralizing Roar
macros.desc: Swipe with auto attack running, or hold Shift for Demoralizing Roar.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Demoralizing Roar; Swipe
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Demoralizing Roar; Swipe
macros.needs: Bear Form or Dire Bear Form
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Rugido Desmoralizante; Patada
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Rugido Desmoralizante; Patada

macros.title: Cat leap into Shred
macros.desc: Leap behind your target with Cat Feral Charge, then press for Shred. The Cat leap has a 30 sec cooldown and does not interrupt or root; check the Cat spell name on your action bar if this cast fails.
macros.needs: Feral Charge talent; Cat Form
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Investida Feral
/startattack
/cast [form:3,harm] Investida Feral
/cast [form:3,harm] Despedaçar

macros.title: Mouseover Rejuvenation
macros.desc: Heal the party frame under your cursor, your target, or yourself.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Rejuvenescer
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Rejuvenescer

macros.title: Mouseover Wild Growth
macros.desc: Heal your friendly mouseover’s or target’s nearby party and pets in seven declining ticks. It’s a 3 sec cast with a 6 sec cooldown. In a raid, the target chooses which party is healed.
macros.needs: Wild Growth talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Crescimento Silvestre
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Crescimento Silvestre

macros.title: Mouseover Regrowth, or your target's target
macros.desc: Regrowth the friendly under your cursor, your target, whoever your enemy target is fighting, or yourself.
macros.needs: Regrowth learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Recrescimento
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead][@player] Recrescimento

macros.title: Healing Touch, Shift for a lower rank
macros.desc: Cast your top rank of Healing Touch on a mouseover, your target or yourself, or hold Shift for Rank 3 when a smaller heal will do; change the number to suit your level.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Healing Touch
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Healing Touch(Rank 3); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Healing Touch

keys.text: Healing Touch at your highest rank

macros.needs: Healing Touch Rank 3 learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Toque de Cura
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Toque de Cura(Grau 3); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Toque de Cura

macros.title: Mouseover Swiftmend
macros.desc: Swiftmend your friendly mouseover, target or yourself. Blizzard said on 30 September the HoT keeps running; the newest tooltip says Swiftmend uses it up, so we’re not sure which is live.
macros.needs: Swiftmend talent; your own Rejuvenation or Regrowth already on the target
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Recomposição Rápida
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Recomposição Rápida

macros.title: Nature's Swiftness into a heal
macros.desc: Leave your form, pop Nature's Swiftness and make your next heal instant: Healing Touch, or Regrowth while you hold Shift.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Nature's Swiftness
/cancelform
/cast Nature's Swiftness
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Regrowth; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Healing Touch
macros.needs: Nature's Swiftness talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Rapidez da Natureza
/cancelform
/cast Rapidez da Natureza
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Recrescimento; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Toque de Cura

macros.title: Rejuvenation, then Swiftmend
macros.desc: Rejuvenation on the first press and Swiftmend on the second, on your friendly target or yourself, so the HoT Swiftmend needs is always your own.
macros.needs: Swiftmend talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [help,nodead][@player] reset=target/6 Rejuvenescer, Recomposição Rápida

macros.title: Rejuvenation by party slot
macros.desc: Rejuvenate yourself, or hold Shift, Ctrl or Alt for party members 1, 2 or 3 without touching a frame.
macros.needs: Rejuvenation learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Rejuvenescer
/cast [mod:shift,@party1,help,nodead][mod:ctrl,@party2,help,nodead][mod:alt,@party3,help,nodead][@player] Rejuvenescer

macros.title: Tranquility, Shift to stop
macros.desc: Leave your form and channel Tranquility. Repeated presses leave the channel running; hold Shift to stop it early.

keys.text: Start Tranquility without restarting an active channel

macros.needs: Tranquility learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tranquilidade
/stopcasting [mod:shift]
/stopmacro [mod:shift]
/cancelform
/cast [nochanneling:Tranquility] Tranquilidade

macros.title: Bash, shifting into Bear Form first
macros.desc: Bash your target, or your mouseover with Shift; if you're not in a bear it puts you in Dire Bear Form first, so the second press lands the stun. Tauren can add War Stomp on Ctrl.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bash
/cast [mod:ctrl] War Stomp; [mod:shift,form:1,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Bash; [form:1] Bash; !Dire Bear Form

keys.text: Bash your target, or Dire Bear Form first if you're not in it

macros.needs: Bash learned; War Stomp is Tauren only
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Trombar
/cast [mod:ctrl] Pisada de Guerra; [mod:shift,form:1,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Trombar; [form:1] Trombar; !Forma de Urso Hediondo

macros.title: Prowl, Dash or Shadowmeld on one key
macros.desc: Go into Cat Form if you need to, then Prowl, or Dash with Shift held; Night Elves get Shadowmeld on Ctrl.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Dash; [mod:ctrl] Shadowmeld; Prowl
/cast [mod:ctrl] Shadowmeld
/cast [noform:3,nomod][noform:3,mod:shift] !Cat Form
/cast [mod:shift] Dash; [nomod] !Prowl

keys.text: Cat Form if needed, then Prowl (out of combat)
Cat Form if needed, then Dash

macros.needs: Prowl and Dash learned; Shadowmeld is Night Elf only
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Arremetida; [mod:ctrl] Fusão Sombria; Espreitar
/cast [mod:ctrl] Fusão Sombria
/cast [noform:3,nomod][noform:3,mod:shift] !Forma de Felino
/cast [mod:shift] Arremetida; [nomod] !Espreitar

macros.title: PvP trinket and Bear Form
macros.desc: Stop your cast, use your top trinket in combat and drop into Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form with Shift.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Cat Form; Dire Bear Form
/stopcasting
/use [combat] 13
/cast [mod:shift,noform:3] !Cat Form; [nomod,noform:1] !Dire Bear Form
macros.needs: A PvP trinket in your top slot, such as the Greater Insignia of the Alliance or of the Horde (Corporal or Grunt rank, 5 min cooldown)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Forma de Felino; Forma de Urso Hediondo
/stopcasting
/use [combat] 13
/cast [mod:shift,noform:3] !Forma de Felino; [nomod,noform:1] !Forma de Urso Hediondo

macros.title: Roots, Shift for Travel Form, Ctrl for Hibernate
macros.desc: Root your mouseover or target, run off in Travel Form with Shift, or put a beast to sleep with Ctrl (a hunter's pet counts). Entangling Roots works indoors as well as outdoors.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Travel Form; [mod:ctrl] Hibernate; Entangling Roots
/cancelform [noform:5,nomod][noform:5,mod:ctrl]
/cast [mod:shift] Travel Form; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Hibernate; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Entangling Roots

keys.text: Entangling Roots on your mouseover or target

macros.needs: Entangling Roots, Hibernate and Travel Form learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Forma de Viagem; [mod:ctrl] Hibernar; Raízes Enredantes
/cancelform [noform:5,nomod][noform:5,mod:ctrl]
/cast [mod:shift] Forma de Viagem; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Hibernar; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Raízes Enredantes

macros.title: Defensive button by modifier
macros.desc: Barkskin on a plain press, Nature's Grasp with Ctrl, or Enrage into Frenzied Regeneration with Shift in Bear Form. Barkskin and Nature's Grasp both work while shapeshifted.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Frenzied Regeneration; [mod:ctrl] Nature's Grasp; Barkskin
/cast [mod:shift,form:1] Enrage
/cast [mod:shift,form:1] Frenzied Regeneration; [mod:ctrl] Nature's Grasp; [nomod] Barkskin
macros.needs: Barkskin, Nature's Grasp and Frenzied Regeneration learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Regeneração Frenética; [mod:ctrl] Enredamento; Pele de Árvore
/cast [mod:shift,form:1] Enfurecer
/cast [mod:shift,form:1] Regeneração Frenética; [mod:ctrl] Enredamento; [nomod] Pele de Árvore

macros.title: Faerie Fire your target or mouseover
macros.desc: Faerie Fire your target, or your mouseover with Shift, to prevent stealth and invisibility. Stay in Bear, Cat, Dire Bear or Moonkin Form; Bear, Cat and Dire Bear casts cost no resources and have a 6 sec cooldown.
macros.needs: Faerie Fire learned We haven’t tested the Faerie Fire cast name in animal forms. If it fails, use the name on your form’s action bar.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Feérico
/cancelform [form:2/4]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm] Fogo Feérico

macros.title: Change form to break a root or snare
macros.desc: Changing form frees you from movement impairing effects, so this always changes it: Cat to Bear, anything else to Cat, Travel Form outdoors with Shift, Aquatic Form with Ctrl.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,outdoors] Travel Form; [mod:ctrl] Aquatic Form; [form:3] Dire Bear Form; Cat Form

keys.text: Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form if you're in Cat Form

macros.needs: Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, Travel Form and Aquatic Form learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,outdoors] Forma de Viagem; [mod:ctrl] Forma Aquática; [form:3] Forma de Urso Hediondo; Forma de Felino

macros.title: Cleanse yourself or a friend
macros.desc: Remove Curse on a mouseover or yourself, Abolish Poison with Shift, and Ctrl or Alt to force either onto yourself. You leave your form first.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Remove Curse
/cancelform
/cast [mod:ctrl,@player] Remove Curse; [mod:alt,@player] Abolish Poison; [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Abolish Poison; [@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Remove Curse

keys.text: Remove Curse on your mouseover or yourself
Abolish Poison on your mouseover or yourself

macros.needs: Remove Curse and Abolish Poison learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Remover Maldição
/cancelform
/cast [mod:ctrl,@player] Remover Maldição; [mod:alt,@player] Abolir Veneno; [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Abolir Veneno; [@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Remover Maldição

macros.title: Moonfire Rank 1 on a shaman totem
macros.desc: Target a Grounding Totem and Moonfire it at Rank 1; Shift for Tremor, Ctrl for Earthbind, Alt for Mana Tide. You stay on the totem, and with none in range the Moonfire hits your target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Moonfire
/target [mod:shift] Tremor Totem; [mod:ctrl] Earthbind Totem; [mod:alt] Mana Tide Totem; Grounding Totem
/cast [harm,nodead] Moonfire(Rank 1)

keys.text: Moonfire Rank 1 on a Grounding Totem
Moonfire Rank 1 on a Tremor Totem
Moonfire Rank 1 on an Earthbind Totem
Moonfire Rank 1 on a Mana Tide Totem

macros.needs: Moonfire learned; caster or Moonkin Form
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Lunar
/target [mod:shift] Tremor Totem; [mod:ctrl] Earthbind Totem; [mod:alt] Mana Tide Totem; Grounding Totem
/cast [harm,nodead] Fogo Lunar(Grau 1)

macros.title: Free Action or Swiftness Potion, staying in form
macros.desc: Drink a Free Action Potion, or a Swiftness Potion while you hold Shift, without leaving your form. Forever lets druids use potions shapeshifted; in Classic you had to shift out first.
macros.needs: Free Action Potion and Swiftness Potion in your bags
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use [mod:shift] Poção de Rapidez; Poção de Ação Desimpedida

macros.title: Drop your cast for an instant
macros.desc: Stop the cast you're on and fire Moonfire at your target; Shift for your mouseover, Ctrl for Insect Swarm, Alt for Faerie Fire.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Moonfire
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:ctrl] Insect Swarm; [mod:alt] Faerie Fire; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Moonfire; Moonfire
macros.needs: Insect Swarm talent for the Ctrl half
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Lunar
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:ctrl] Nuvem de Insetos; [mod:alt] Fogo Feérico; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Fogo Lunar; Fogo Lunar

macros.title: Back into Moonkin Form to break a root
macros.desc: Re-enter Moonkin Form to shake off a root, snare or Polymorph; from Moonkin it can take a second press. Hold Shift for Dire Bear Form when a rogue jumps you, or Ctrl for Travel Form outdoors.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Dire Bear Form; [mod:ctrl] Travel Form; Moonkin Form
/cancelform [mod:shift,noform:1][mod:ctrl,noform:4][nomod]
/cast [mod:shift] !Dire Bear Form; [mod:ctrl] !Travel Form; !Moonkin Form

keys.text: Moonkin Form, leaving it first if you're already in it

macros.needs: Moonkin Form talent; Dire Bear Form and Travel Form learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Forma de Urso Hediondo; [mod:ctrl] Forma de Viagem; Forma de Luniscante
/cancelform [mod:shift,noform:1][mod:ctrl,noform:4][nomod]
/cast [mod:shift] !Forma de Urso Hediondo; [mod:ctrl] !Forma de Viagem; !Forma de Luniscante

macros.title: Cleanse or Innervate without leaving Moonkin
macros.desc: Remove Curse on your mouseover or yourself, Abolish Poison with Shift, or Innervate yourself with Ctrl. Forever's Moonkin Form only blocks healing spells, so it stays up; other forms drop.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:ctrl] Innervate; [mod:shift] Abolish Poison; Remove Curse
/cancelform [noform:5]
/cast [mod:ctrl,@player] Innervate; [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Abolish Poison; [@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Remove Curse

keys.text: Remove Curse on your mouseover or yourself
Abolish Poison on your mouseover or yourself

macros.needs: Moonkin Form talent; Remove Curse, Abolish Poison and Innervate learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:ctrl] Avivar; [mod:shift] Abolir Veneno; Remover Maldição
/cancelform [noform:5]
/cast [mod:ctrl,@player] Avivar; [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Abolir Veneno; [@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Remover Maldição

macros.title: Regrowth, then back into Moonkin Form
macros.desc: Moonkin Form blocks heals, so this drops it and casts Regrowth on you; the next press shifts you back in. The sequence starts over after 10 seconds without a press.
macros.needs: Moonkin Form talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cancelform
/castsequence [@player] reset=10 Recrescimento, Forma de Luniscante

macros.title: Trinket and Elune's Light into Starfire
macros.desc: Starfire on a plain press. Hold Shift to fire your bottom trinket and Elune's Light first. We haven't checked whether Elune's Light triggers the global cooldown; if it does, press again for the Starfire.

keys.text: Bottom trinket and Elune's Light, then Starfire

macros.needs: Starfire learned; an on-use trinket in your bottom slot; Elune's Light is Night Elf only
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Estelar
/use [mod:shift] 14
/cast [mod:shift] Luz de Eluna
/cast Fogo Estelar

macros.title: Pounce from Prowl, then Entangling Roots
macros.desc: Pounce from Prowl to stun, then press again to drop Cat Form and start Entangling Roots while they are still stunned. Pounce needs you behind the target, and its bleed can break the root.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth] Pounce; Entangling Roots
/cancelform [nostealth,noform:5]
/cast [stealth] Pounce; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Entangling Roots
macros.needs: Cat Form and Prowl; Improved Entangling Roots talent helps the root hold through the bleed
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth] Pulo do Gato; Raízes Enredantes
/cancelform [nostealth,noform:5]
/cast [stealth] Pulo do Gato; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Raízes Enredantes

macros.title: Root whatever your friend is fighting
macros.desc: Root the enemy under your cursor, or hover a friend's frame to root what they've targeted; otherwise your enemy target, or your friendly target's target. Without Overgrowth a new root frees the last one.
macros.needs: Entangling Roots learned; Overgrowth talent to hold more than one root
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raízes Enredantes
/cancelform [noform:5]
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][@mouseovertarget,harm,nodead][harm,nodead][@targettarget,harm,nodead] Raízes Enredantes

macros.title: Enrage, charge and Bash
macros.desc: In Bear Form it Enrages for the Rage (your armor drops for 10 seconds), charges and Bashes; press again if the Bash was short on Rage. From any other form the first press only changes your form.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Feral Charge
/cast [noform:1] !Dire Bear Form
/cast [form:1] Enrage
/cast [form:1,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][form:1,harm] Feral Charge
/cast [form:1,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][form:1,harm] Bash
macros.needs: Feral Charge talent; Bash learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Investida Feral
/cast [noform:1] !Forma de Urso Hediondo
/cast [form:1] Enfurecer
/cast [form:1,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][form:1,harm] Investida Feral
/cast [form:1,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][form:1,harm] Trombar

macros.title: Pounce from stealth, Shift for Ravage
macros.desc: Stun with Pounce from Prowl, or open with Ravage while you hold Shift; out of stealth it falls back to Rake. Both openers need you behind the target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth,mod:shift] Ravage; [stealth] Pounce; Rake
/startattack [nostealth]
/cast [stealth,mod:shift] Ravage; [stealth] Pounce; Rake
macros.needs: Cat Form; behind your target
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth,mod:shift] Assolar; [stealth] Pulo do Gato; Estraçalhar
/startattack [nostealth]
/cast [stealth,mod:shift] Assolar; [stealth] Pulo do Gato; Estraçalhar

macros.title: Feral Charge with Nature's Grasp
macros.desc: In Bear Form, charge your mouseover or target and raise Nature's Grasp in the same press, so the next melee hit on you roots its attacker. Out of Bear Form the first press shifts you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Feral Charge
/cast [noform:1] !Dire Bear Form
/cast [form:1,@mouseover,harm,nodead][form:1,harm] Feral Charge
/cast [form:1] Nature's Grasp
macros.needs: Feral Charge talent; Nature's Grasp, which Forever lets you cast in form
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Investida Feral
/cast [noform:1] !Forma de Urso Hediondo
/cast [form:1,@mouseover,harm,nodead][form:1,harm] Investida Feral
/cast [form:1] Enredamento

macros.title: Heal yourself, then back into Cat Form
macros.desc: Drop your form for Rejuvenation and then Regrowth on yourself; the third press puts you back in Cat Form. The sequence starts over after 12 seconds without a press.
macros.needs: Cat Form and Regrowth learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cancelform
/castsequence [@player] reset=12 Rejuvenescer, Recrescimento, Forma de Felino

macros.title: Dash and Barkskin in Cat Form
macros.desc: Dash and Barkskin together in Cat Form, since Dash is off the global cooldown. Out of Cat Form the first press shifts you, which also frees you from roots and snares.
macros.needs: Dash and Barkskin learned; Barkskin works in Cat Form in Forever
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Arremetida
/cast [noform:3] !Forma de Felino
/cast [form:3] Arremetida
/cast [form:3] Pele de Árvore

macros.title: Cat leap and Faerie Fire on one press
macros.desc: Leap behind your target with Cat Feral Charge and Faerie Fire it in the same press, so it can't stealth or turn invisible. If either cast fails, check the name on your Cat action bar.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Feral Charge
/startattack
/cast [form:3,harm] Feral Charge
/cast [form:3,harm] Faerie Fire
macros.needs: Feral Charge talent; Cat Form; 8 to 25 yards from your target
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Investida Feral
/startattack
/cast [form:3,harm] Investida Feral
/cast [form:3,harm] Fogo Feérico

macros.title: Instant heal or instant root
macros.desc: Nature's Swiftness into Healing Touch on a mouseover or yourself, or into an instant Entangling Roots on your target while you hold Shift.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Nature's Swiftness
/cancelform [mod:shift,noform:5][nomod]
/cast [mod:shift,harm][nomod] Nature's Swiftness
/cast [mod:shift,harm] Entangling Roots; [nomod,@mouseover,help,nodead][nomod,@player] Healing Touch

Nature's Swiftness, then Entangling Roots on your target

/cast [mod:shift,harm] Raízes Enredantes; [nomod,@mouseover,help,nodead][nomod,@player] Toque de Cura

macros.title: Instant heals on the move
macros.desc: Rejuvenation on a plain press or Swiftmend with Shift, both instant, on your mouseover or yourself. You leave your form first.

keys.text: Rejuvenation on your mouseover or yourself
Swiftmend on your mouseover or yourself

/cancelform
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Recomposição Rápida; [@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Rejuvenescer

macros.title: Nature's Swiftness into Hibernate
macros.desc: Leave your form and put a beast or dragonkin to sleep instantly, on your mouseover or enemy target; a hunter's pet is the usual pick. If the cast can't start, Nature's Swiftness stays up.
macros.needs: Nature's Swiftness talent; Hibernate learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Hibernar
/cancelform
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Rapidez da Natureza
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Hibernar

/stopcasting
/cancelform
/cast Nature's Swiftness
/cast [mod:shift,@party1,nodead][mod:ctrl,@party2,nodead][mod:alt,@party3,nodead][@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Healing Touch

/cancelform

macros.desc: Keep an enemy targeted and Rejuvenate whoever it has targeted, or Swiftmend them with Shift. A friendly target gets the heal instead, and you are the fallback. You leave your form first.

Swiftmend on your friendly target, your enemy target's target or yourself

macros.title: Rejuvenation, then back into Travel Form
macros.desc: For flag runs and kiting: drop Travel Form and Rejuvenate yourself, then press again to shift back. Travel Form only works outdoors, and the sequence starts over after 12 seconds without a press.
macros.needs: Travel Form learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cancelform
/castsequence [@player] reset=12 Rejuvenescer, Forma de Viagem

macros.title: Nature's Swiftness into Rebirth
macros.desc: Bring back the dead player under your cursor, or your target, with an instant Rebirth in the middle of a fight. You leave your form first, and Rebirth has a 30 min cooldown.
macros.needs: Nature's Swiftness talent; Rebirth learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Renascimento
/cancelform
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead][help,dead] Rapidez da Natureza
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead][help,dead] Renascimento
